The '''Blazikenite''' (Japanese: '''バシャーモナイト''' ''Bursyamonite'') is a type of [[held item]] introduced in [[Generation VI]]. It is the [[Mega Stone]] that allows {{p|Blaziken}} to [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolve]] into Mega Blaziken.

==In the core series games==
===Price===
{{ItemPrice/head|items}}
{{ItemPrice|{{gameabbrev6|XYORAS}}<br>{{gameabbrev7|SMUSUM}}|N/A|N/A}}
|}
|}

===Effect===
====In battle====
If held by a {{p|Blaziken}}, the Blazikenite allows it to [[Mega Evolution|Mega Evolve]] into Mega Blaziken if its {{pkmn|Trainer}} has a [[Key Stone]]. A Trainer can only Mega Evolve one Pokémon per battle (or only have one Mega-Evolved Pokémon at any given moment{{sup/9|ZA}}).

As a [[Mega Stone]], it is unaffected by item-negating effects (such as {{m|Embargo}} and {{a|Klutz}}). Item-manipulating effects (such as {{m|Trick}} and {{m|Fling}}) cannot give or remove a Blazikenite from Blaziken.

====Outside of battle====
If held by a Blaziken, the Blazikenite allows it to Mega Evolve into Mega Blaziken when it performs a {{DL|Appeal|Spectacular Talent}} during a [[Pokémon Contest|Pokémon Contest Spectacular]] if its Trainer has a Key Stone. Blaziken will remain a Mega Blaziken until the [[Pokémon Contest#Secondary judging|Talent Round]] ends.

==In spin-off games==
===Pokémon Shuffle===
In [[Pokémon Shuffle]], the Blazikenite allows the player to [[Mega Evolution (Shuffle)|Mega Evolve]] {{p|Blaziken}}.

The player can obtain the Blazikenite by completing [[Mission Card#Mission Card #17|Mission Card 17]].

The Blazikenite was also available as a prize during the Mega Blaziken [[competitive stage]] during the game's [[Competitive stage/Live service period|live service period]]:
* July 20 to 27, 2015 (3DS only)
* April 19 to 26, 2016 (3DS and Mobile)

The Blazikenite enables the following Mega Evolutions:

{{ShuffleMegaStone}}
{{ShuffleMegaStone/entry|stone=Blazikenite|257|Blaziken|Fire|Replaces Pokémon (max 3) of the same type as Mega Blaziken.|note=Converts three tiles containing a single Fire type into Mega Blaziken.|12|{{tt|6|3 prior to Version 1.4.6 (3DS)/1.10 (Mobile)}}}}
{{ShuffleMegaStone/foot}}
